changelog: Added 1x, 2x, 3x and 4x speed multiplier buttons to accelerate virtual traffic pacing and simulation clock on the fly.
Added approach controls in Simple mode: order a go-around (remise de gaz) or hold at any time for approaching aircraft.
Emergency priority landings automatically wave off conflicting traffic on the runway.
Added in-game 3D raycast runway placement tool in /conf_acn_airtraffic with laser preview and auto QFU designation.
Enhanced visual interface with airline brand badges and cleaner status cards.
New Simple mode (default): pilots send requests and you answer with one or two big buttons; aircraft fly and taxi on their own. Expert mode still available.
Guided tutorial with training traffic on the first shift, plus a Help button.
Controller NPC and map blip at the tower post, easier post placement (left click or E) and a setup guide in /conf_acn_airtraffic.
Brand-new controller interface: sharp radar with non-overlapping labels, compact flight strips, heading dial and clearer orders.
Redesigned admin panel with a better airport map editor, on-demand crisis trigger, Advanced tuning tab and full French translation.
Fixed the post getting locked for everyone, the player sinking into the floor, the target vanishing after an acn_bridge restart and the cursor on the session report.
First release: virtual air traffic controller job with a modern radar, flight strips and a full set of aircraft orders.
Random and scripted crises, 5 editable grades with XP and pay, and a session report.
/conf_acn_airtraffic configures everything live in game, including raycast placement of the tower post and a visual airport map editor.
